Packages for Linux (x86_64 and arm64) and Windows 10/11 (x64). Requires the OpenSSH client (`ssh`), which Windows 10/11 already includes.

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 | `_x64-setup.exe` (recommended) or `.msi` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Linux Mint, Pop!_OS | `.deb` (`amd64` / `arm64`) |
| Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL | `.rpm` (`x86_64` / `aarch64`) |
| Arch Linux, CachyOS, EndeavourOS, Manjaro | `.pkg.tar.zst` (x86_64) |
| Any other distribution | `.AppImage` |

Windows: the installer is not code-signed yet. If SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC", choose *More info* → *Run anyway*.

📦 Step-by-step instructions: https://github.com/alex-1987/Crabshell#installation
